digest.component_or_area: review-bot container deployment and code review voting
propositions: auto-deploy restarts the review-bot container mid-flight code review, interrupting the review and causing a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks automatic recovery
the shutdown drain timeout (45s) is too short relative to review duration (up to 911s observed), causing the drain to expire and cancel in-flight reviews before they complete
the reconciler treats a fail-closed -1 vote as terminal and skips re-driving, making transient errors (git fetch timeout, llm unavailable, scanner errors) permanently unrecoverable

retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should defer voting and remain vote-less so the backfill reconciler re-drives them instead of blocking recovery
after N consecutive retryable failures on the same change revision, the system should escalate by casting a fail-closed -1 with an exhausted-retries note and emitting a CloudWatch alarm
teardown-corrupted reviews that fail-close as review-error should be treated as retryable and deferred vote-less, not cast as permanent vetoes
